module_summary: Serial-triggered timer: an FSM detects 1101, shifts in a 4-bit delay, counts (delay+1)*1000 cycles via a 1000-cycle prescaler and down-counter, then waits for ack.

anchors.name: state
anchors.why: Main FSM: pattern search, four shift states, Count and Wait; drives shift_ena, counting, done.

anchors.name: scount
anchors.why: Shifts in delay[3:0], then decrements every 1000 cycles; remaining-time value.

anchors.name: fcount
anchors.why: 0..999 prescaler running while counting; wrap decrements scount.

anchors.name: done_counting
anchors.why: Timer expiry (scount==0, fcount==999); moves FSM from Count to Wait.

anchors.name: counting
anchors.why: Count-state flag; enables fcount, scount decrement and count output.

anchors.name: shift_ena
anchors.why: Asserted in B0..B3; shifts data into scount.

anchors.name: done
anchors.why: Timeout notification held in Wait state until ack.

anchors.name: ack
anchors.why: User acknowledge; returns FSM from Wait to pattern search.

anchors.name: data
anchors.why: Serial input for 1101 detection and delay bits.

anchors.name: count
anchors.why: Remaining-time output, scount gated by counting.

groups.name: timer_fsm
groups.description: Pattern detect, delay shift, count and wait-for-ack sequencing with decoded control outputs.

groups.name: delay_counters
groups.description: Delay shift/down-counter scount and 1000-cycle prescaler fcount with expiry detect.
